replay_method: Reconstruct the complete declared support hypergraph from consumers, without assuming the primary block theorem. Use C2 Q_ALL only after independently checking that every consumer support is contained in its incidences.

unary_effects: chi_S, chi_X0, exact A and source-list class are unary coordinates after B2B2-B.
dynamic_constraints: Proper-coloring coupling among still-live dynamic vertices occurs only on edges of G[U].
Those edges are copied exactly into Q_ALL.
component_future_scope: Every residual component C can affect future semantics only through its boundary D_C plus its internally compiled message/base-list state.
Q_ALL has one node [C] adjacent exactly to D_C.
Even if current MIN_BAD(C)=empty and H* contains no selector for C, later fixed/X0 effects may change the message. Therefore [C]-D_C must remain in the future dependency object.
This validates Q_ALL rather than current H* as the future-complete block skeleton.
B0_support: Frozen old provenance is per survivor.
The mutable B0 hard coordinates are survivor relational structure and component incidence.
An actual survivor-survivor edge is a dynamic edge of Q_ALL; survivor-component incidence is a u-[C] edge.
No extra cross-QALL support is introduced.
B2A_C3_support: C3 selectors refine a single component scope D_C.
B2A rho/message/delta signatures use one component, its D_C and target dynamic vertices from that same incidence block.
No support leaves the Q_ALL block containing [C].
R1_factorization: Fixing u=c modifies only unary effects and descendants inside the ancestor Q_ALL block of u.
Every other block is unchanged except that global extension requires its ordinary feasibility.
Hence global R1 equals target-block local R1 AND all untouched-block feasibility bits.
R2_cross_block_factorization: If u and v lie in different Q_ALL blocks, there is no dynamic edge or component carrier spanning the blocks.
The condition u=v=c is two independent unary forced-color conditions, one in each block.
Therefore global R2 is local R1(u,c) AND local R1(v,c) AND base feasibility of all other blocks.
The shared color symbol c is a constant label, not a coupling variable.
future_block_invariance: Authorized forcing creates no graph edge.
Retained residual components never gain boundary vertices; D_C only shrinks as dynamic vertices are fixed/deleted.
When a removed residual component contributes vertices to the dynamic side, every outside dynamic neighbor of that old component was already in D_C and therefore in the same ancestor Q_ALL block.
Unary seed/X0 effects cannot bridge blocks.
reconstruction: Every residual component C and all D_C vertices belong to one Q_ALL block by incidence through [C].
C0/C3 reconstruction for C is therefore block-local.
Deleted repair components have independent receipts and are assigned to their ancestor block.
Global reconstruction is concatenation of block reconstructions plus the fixed assignment ledger.
portfolio: Disconnected Q_ALL blocks have no undeclared semantic/source/reconstruction hyperedge between them.
Boolean AND of block feasibility bits and concatenation of receipts is polynomial glue.
The sealed factorized-feedback theorem therefore closes cross-block Cartesian multiplicity provided local block carriers are available.
connected_core_firewall: No polynomial exact carrier for arbitrary connected Q_ALL dynamic core is supplied by C0/C2/C3/B2A alone.
Therefore the audit cannot promote PASS_POLYNOMIAL_FACTORIZED_FORCED_STATE_REPRESENTATION globally.
The exact remaining obligation is local to one connected Q_ALL block.
